source_available: Maintained SEED.md P04 summary, author mandate and narrative-production guidance. Historical Lightnovel Darkfantasy v0.4.48.zip and its full manuscript are not present in this checkout. Archive inventory contains Rave/WebSocket families, not P04 prose.
retained_seed_elements: Aevren reconstructs older knowledge, rather than inventing all world systems
Darsen is cosmopolitan; nonhuman workers have practical agency
A small maintenance/intrusion incident can demonstrate a rule of the world
new_adaptation_choices: New Sava/Nera/Lesto/Eno/Tila, plot, waterworks and social arrangements. Broad Saelir hands are a local character detail, not an asserted historical species canon.

Corpse muscle requires contact/intact tissue; no resurrection, answering soul, healing of broken joints or remote worker intelligence. Aevren own embodied existence is assumed by the lich premise, not a new full cosmology.
Baldino remains alive and narrates witnessed events after the incident; no ghost/post-death knowledge. No fixed year or Aevren/Garran/Dorian identity equivalence.
Sava emergency permission to use the body is constrained, not portrayed as unpressured consent or forgiveness. Water cleanup, injuries, family testimony and pending accountability follow the rescue.

glossary.Rua do Sal: Salt Street; translate this descriptive street name, retain Darsen and personal names.
glossary.registro: wash valve in the pipe passage; maintenance ledger/entry for signed records.
glossary.grade / grelha: hanging grille / outlet screen; distinguish the fatal corridor barrier from the blocked water outlet.
glossary.tomada / entrada / saída / descarga: intake / inlet / outlet / drain; the drain opens to the river and leaks back through the cracked wall.
glossary.comporta / freio / contrapeso: sluice gate / brake / counterweight; keep the order of fitting the beam, releasing the chain and lifting the gate.
glossary.viga / alça: beam / loop; specify the spare brace separately from the operating beam.
glossary.cabo: cable for the grille; handle in the wheel/brake context.
glossary.chave: wrench for Sava; house key for Tila; service key for Lesto.
glossary.saelir: retain source name/lowercase without inventing a species glossary.
glossary.intimação: summons; punishment and payment remain undecided.
glossary.cobrir Lesto: shroud Lesto, inferred from the final body-preparation scene; no burial place or additional rite introduced.

translation.editorial_interpretation: The source passage says me largou pelo casaco. Let go of the beam and seized my coat resolves the awkward wording against the following order to hold the beam again and the explicit no-blow clause. This is a reasoned translator choice; the Portuguese source stays intact.
translation.voice_and_continuity: Baldino remains self-excusing, observant and accountable; Aevren practical/possessive, Sava technically decisive with constrained permission and grief, Nera terse about public water. Contact/intact joints remain necessary; no resurrection/remote command. Retain book loss, damaged hands/shoulder, daughter ignorance, delayed summons and demanded testimony.
translation.review: Whole source/translation compared paragraph by paragraph by the implementing translator. Five headings and 240 paragraph positions align; eight personal/place-name occurrence counts agree. These structural checks are not a semantic or independent literary assessment.
